newsitem.title: USA: Casino Data Systems video system approved.
newsitem.headline: Casino Data Systems video system approved.

text.p: Casino Data Systems said Tuesday that the Nevada Gaming Commission granted unanimous final approval of its video poker platform.
The company can, with this approval, immediately begin the commercial sale of video poker slot devices throughout Nevada.

The company began field trial of its video poker platform in May in Las Vegas at Bally's and Texas Station. The company intends to immediately begin marketing throughout Nevada where there are over 185,000 slot machines now in operation.
